about: Statements of the readers of repo_metrics_daily.change_failure_rate and of dora_metrics_daily as they were BEFORE CHAOS-8981, with their bindings and the results they returned on the schema of that commit (ClickHouse migrations 000-111) over rows written by that commit's repo_metrics_daily writer. Recorded by running each reader at ops_sha against a real ClickHouse; the acr statement text is copied from acr_sha. The replay test seeds the same logical rows on the migrated schema and requires the same column types and values.

statements.sql:
SELECT
			toInt64(count()) AS row_count,
            toFloat64(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS value
        FROM (
            SELECT
                day,
                repo_id,
                argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
            FROM repo_metrics_daily
            WHERE day >= {start_day:Date} AND day < {end_day:Date}
            
              AND org_id = {org_id:String}
            GROUP BY day, repo_id
        )

SELECT
            day,
            toFloat64(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS value
        FROM (
            SELECT
                day,
                repo_id,
                argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
            FROM repo_metrics_daily
            WHERE day >= {start_day:Date} AND day < {end_day:Date}
            
              AND org_id = {org_id:String}
            GROUP BY day, repo_id
        )
        GROUP BY day
        ORDER BY day

SELECT
            current.id AS id,
            current.value AS value,
            CASE WHEN previous.value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (current.value - previous.value) / previous.value * 100 END AS delta_pct
        FROM (
            SELECT repo_id AS id, avg(change_failure_rate) AS value
            FROM (
            SELECT
                day,
                repo_id,
                argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
            FROM repo_metrics_daily
            WHERE day >= {start_day:Date} AND day < {end_day:Date}
            
              AND org_id = {org_id:String}
            GROUP BY day, repo_id
        )
            GROUP BY repo_id
        ) AS current
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT repo_id AS id, avg(change_failure_rate) AS value
            FROM (
            SELECT
                day,
                repo_id,
                argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
            FROM repo_metrics_daily
            WHERE day >= {compare_start:Date} AND day < {compare_end:Date}
            
              AND org_id = {org_id:String}
            GROUP BY day, repo_id
        )
            GROUP BY repo_id
        ) AS previous ON current.id = previous.id
        ORDER BY delta_pct DESC
        LIMIT {limit:UInt32}

SELECT toString(repo_id), toString(day), toInt64(commits_count), toInt64(prs_merged), toFloat64(median_pr_cycle_hours), toFloat64(change_failure_rate), toUInt8(isNotNull(mttr_hours)), toFloat64(ifNull(mttr_hours, 0)), toInt64(bus_factor), toFloat64(code_ownership_gini), toInt64(total_days)
FROM (
	SELECT repo_id, day, commits_count, prs_merged, median_pr_cycle_hours, change_failure_rate, mttr_hours, bus_factor, code_ownership_gini,
		count() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id) AS total_days
	FROM (
		SELECT repo_id, day, commits_count, prs_merged, median_pr_cycle_hours, change_failure_rate, mttr_hours, bus_factor, code_ownership_gini,
			row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, day ORDER BY computed_at DESC, cityHash64(tuple(commits_count, prs_merged, median_pr_cycle_hours, change_failure_rate, ifNull(mttr_hours, -1), bus_factor, code_ownership_gini)) DESC) AS rn
		FROM repo_metrics_daily
		WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND toString(repo_id) IN {ids:Array(String)} AND day >= toDate({series_window_start:DateTime64(6,'UTC')}) AND day <= toDate({series_window_end:DateTime64(6,'UTC')})
	)
	WHERE rn = 1
)
ORDER BY repo_id, day DESC
LIMIT 200 BY repo_id

SELECT
    toFloat64(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS value,
    count(change_failure_rate) AS known_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        day,
        repo_id,
        argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
    FROM repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE day >= {start_day:Date} AND day < {end_day:Date}
    
      AND org_id = {org_id:String}
    GROUP BY day,
        repo_id
)
SETTINGS max_execution_time = 30

SELECT
    toString(repo_id) AS id,
    toFloat64(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS value
FROM (
    SELECT
        day,
        repo_id,
        argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
    FROM repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE day >= {start_day:Date} AND day < {end_day:Date}
    
      AND org_id = {org_id:String}
    GROUP BY day,
        repo_id
)
GROUP BY repo_id
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT {limit:UInt64}
SETTINGS max_execution_time = 30

SELECT
    current.id AS id,
    current.value AS value,
    CASE WHEN previous.value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (current.value - previous.value) / previous.value * 100 END AS delta_pct
FROM (
    SELECT toString(repo_id) AS id, toFloat64(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS value
    FROM (
    SELECT
        day,
        repo_id,
        argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
    FROM repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE day >= {start_day:Date} AND day < {end_day:Date}
    
      AND org_id = {org_id:String}
    GROUP BY day,
        repo_id
)
    GROUP BY repo_id
) AS current
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT toString(repo_id) AS id, toFloat64(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS value
    FROM (
    SELECT
        day,
        repo_id,
        argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate
    FROM repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE day >= {compare_start:Date} AND day < {compare_end:Date}
    
      AND org_id = {org_id:String}
    GROUP BY day,
        repo_id
)
    GROUP BY repo_id
) AS previous ON current.id = previous.id
ORDER BY delta_pct DESC
LIMIT {limit:UInt64}
SETTINGS max_execution_time = 30

SELECT
          sum(prs_merged) AS prs_merged,
          avg(pr_first_review_p50_hours) AS pr_first_review_p50_hours,
          avg(single_owner_file_ratio_30d) AS single_owner_file_ratio_30d,
          avg(code_ownership_gini) AS code_ownership_gini,
          min(bus_factor) AS bus_factor,
          avg(change_failure_rate) AS change_failure_rate,
          avg(mttr_hours) AS mttr_hours,
          count() AS repo_metrics_known_count
        FROM (
          SELECT
            day,
            repo_id,
            argMax(prs_merged, computed_at) AS prs_merged,
            (argMax(tuple(pr_first_review_p50_hours), computed_at)).1 AS pr_first_review_p50_hours,
            argMax(single_owner_file_ratio_30d, computed_at) AS single_owner_file_ratio_30d,
            argMax(code_ownership_gini, computed_at) AS code_ownership_gini,
            argMax(bus_factor, computed_at) AS bus_factor,
            argMax(change_failure_rate, computed_at) AS change_failure_rate,
            (argMax(tuple(mttr_hours), computed_at)).1 AS mttr_hours
          FROM repo_metrics_daily
          WHERE org_id = {org_id:String}
            AND day >= {start:Date} AND day < {end:Date}
          GROUP BY day, repo_id
        )

SELECT
    toString(repo_id) AS entity_id,
    uniqExact(day) AS data_days,
    toNullable(avg(pr_first_review_p50_hours)) AS pr_first_review_p50_hours,
    toNullable(avg(pr_rework_ratio)) AS pr_rework_ratio,
    toNullable(avg(rework_churn_ratio_30d)) AS rework_churn_ratio_30d,
    toNullable(avg(change_failure_rate)) AS change_failure_rate
FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE org_id = {org_id:String}
    ORDER BY computed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1 BY org_id, repo_id, day
) AS repo_metrics_daily
WHERE day >= today() - {window_days:UInt32}
  AND org_id = {org_id:String}
GROUP BY repo_id
HAVING data_days >= 5
ORDER BY data_days DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
        toDate(day) AS x,
        CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)') AS group_value,
        avg(change_failure_rate) AS y
    FROM (SELECT * FROM repo_metrics_daily ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY org_id, repo_id, day) AS repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE
        change_failure_rate IS NOT NULL AND
        org_id = {org_id:String} AND
        day >= {time_range_start:Date} AND
        day <= {time_range_end:Date}
    GROUP BY x
    ORDER BY x

SELECT
        repo_id AS x,
        CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)') AS group_value,
        avg(change_failure_rate) AS y
    FROM (SELECT * FROM repo_metrics_daily ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY org_id, repo_id, day) AS repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE
        change_failure_rate IS NOT NULL AND
        org_id = {org_id:String} AND
        day >= {time_range_start:Date} AND
        day <= {time_range_end:Date}
    GROUP BY x
    ORDER BY y DESC, x

SELECT
        CAST('total', 'String') AS x,
        CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)') AS group_value,
        avg(change_failure_rate) AS y
    FROM (SELECT * FROM repo_metrics_daily ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY org_id, repo_id, day) AS repo_metrics_daily
    WHERE
        change_failure_rate IS NOT NULL AND
        org_id = {org_id:String} AND
        day >= {time_range_start:Date} AND
        day <= {time_range_end:Date}

SELECT
        toDate(day) AS x,
        CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)') AS group_value,
        avg(value) AS y
    FROM (SELECT * FROM dora_metrics_daily ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY org_id, repo_id, day, metric_name) AS dora_metrics_daily
    WHERE
        value IS NOT NULL AND
        org_id = {org_id:String} AND
        day >= {time_range_start:Date} AND
        day <= {time_range_end:Date}
    GROUP BY x
    ORDER BY x

SELECT
        repo_id AS x,
        CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(String)') AS group_value,
        avg(value) AS y
    FROM (SELECT * FROM dora_metrics_daily ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY org_id, repo_id, day, metric_name) AS dora_metrics_daily
    WHERE
        value IS NOT NULL AND
        org_id = {org_id:String} AND
        day >= {time_range_start:Date} AND
        day <= {time_range_end:Date}
    GROUP BY x
    ORDER BY y DESC, x
